Container.Name: Subtitle Edit
Container.Overview: Run native Linux Subtitle Edit in a web browser. Includes FFmpeg, MPV, Tesseract OCR, persistent settings and optional GPU acceleration. No Wine or virtual machine is used.
Container.Requires: AMD64 Unraid. CPU mode needs no GPU setting. Intel/AMD: set the optional GPU device to /dev/dri. NVIDIA: install the Unraid Nvidia Driver and set Extra Parameters to --runtime=nvidia --gpus all --shm-size=1g. Direct HTTPS uses a self-signed certificate.

Branch.TagDescription: Latest tested stable Subtitle Edit release. Recommended for normal use.
Latest tested Subtitle Edit beta. Use a separate appdata directory when evaluating it.

Config.Name: Web UI HTTPS
Config.Description: Direct HTTPS access using Selkies' self-signed certificate. Change the host port if 3001 is already in use.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Subtitle Edit settings, desktop configuration, OCR databases, and downloaded models.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Media and subtitle files. Select files under /data inside Subtitle Edit.

Config.Name: Web password
Config.Description: Selkies HTTP Basic Authentication password. Do not leave blank.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU device (optional)
Config.Description: Enter /dev/dri for Intel/AMD acceleration. Leave blank for CPU mode or NVIDIA; NVIDIA uses the Extra Parameters field instead.

Config.Name: Automatic GPU
Config.Description: Automatically use the first GPU made available to the container for rendering and browser-stream encoding.
